lines.en: I stride through the bamboo on long legs.
My casque knocks as I walk.

lines.zh: 我甩着脖子上的肉垂走。
lines.en: I walk swinging my wattles.
I weave between bamboo stalks.
I close in along the bamboo edge.
Fallen leaves rustle under me.
I walk with my head low.
I stop abruptly, then go on.
I step around a bamboo clump.
I lift my feet high.
I step clear over a whole bamboo clump.
I come out of the bamboo.
I close in an inch at a time.
I turn, my neck swinging.
My claws drag on the dirt.
I keep walking one way.
My casque shines in the light.
I hold still like a bamboo stalk.
I listen to the bamboo.
My wattles sway gently.
I turn my casque toward the bamboo shadows.
My feathers are black and hard.
I stretch my neck slowly.
I make a very low sound.
I wait at the bamboo's edge.
I ruffle my feathers.
My eyes are small and fierce.
I raise one foot.
You are standing far too close.
My casque points at you.
I do not retreat, and do not call.
You move a step, and so do I.
Keep staring at me and I'll kick you.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我的眼睛一直跟着你。
lines.en: Here in the bamboo, my eyes never leave you.
My black feathers flare, and I lower my neck.
I let out a shrill cry.
I stand on one leg and pull my neck back.
I turn my body aside.
I shake myself.
I stare at you in silence.
My claws grip harder.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我的头冠是蓝的。
lines.en: In the bamboo, my casque is blue.
I retreat to the bamboo's edge.
I look down at it.
I am not so easily soothed.
I give it a small peck.
Only watermelon interests me.
I raise my eyes to you again.
Only a slice of watermelon makes me bow my head.
I tilt my head, unimpressed.
Watermelon? Then I'll stop chasing you for now.
You rammed in; dust flew up.
I raise a foot and push you.

lines.zh: 撞上来的是你，疼的是你
lines.en: You are the one who hit me, and you are the one hurt.
I am knocked to one side.
I steady myself, claws biting the ground.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪在地上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claws rake the ground.
We land one heavy thump.
I am not the least afraid.

lines.zh: 两只鹤鸵在竹林里绕圈。
lines.en: Two cassowaries circle in the bamboo.
We lower our heads toward each other.
It scrapes a hollow in the earth.
We dig in the earth together.
Our casques touch.
It walks at my flank.
We lower our heads to forage together.
Their necks sway together.
Neither of us calls.

lines.zh: 我们一起走进竹林深处。
lines.en: We walk into the deep bamboo together.
I take a slice of melon.
I toss it and catch it.
I tip my head back and the melon slides down.
I shake my head and swallow.
I look at it two seconds, then eat.
I kick it away.
I peck at it twice.
I toss it away with a flick of my head.
I peck at its edge.
I caught that noise over there.
I turn that way.

lines.zh: 我的头冠是蓝的，脾气更糟。
lines.en: Blue casque, worse temper.
Closing in bit by bit. Don't startle it.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住地面，随时发力。
lines.en: My claws dig in, ready to push.
A bamboo leaf rustles, and I turn toward it.
I have it in sight in the bamboo.
You've walked into my bamboo grove.
I follow it step by step.
Wherever it runs, I see it.
I come around through the bamboo.
I am not fast, but I close in.
It makes too much noise.
I follow along the stalks.
It backs off, and I press forward.
My feet come up high.
I kick it with one foot.
My claw opens its hide.
I drive my casque into it.
I ram it with my whole body.
It gets flipped by my kick.
I lower my head and stab with my beak.
My legs are long, my reach is far.
It backs off; I take a step after.
My claws press it down.
I add another kick.
A dark shape appears in the bamboo.
I step out from behind a stalk.
The leaves on the ground rustle.
I begin moving through the bamboo.
You hear heavy footsteps.

lines.zh: 一个长脖子在竹子间晃。
lines.en: A long neck sways between stalks.
I come slowly out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 这里的竹子被我撞得直晃。
lines.en: The bamboo sways where I brush it.
I stop not far in front of you.
I scrape the ground with a claw.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到我的羽毛，我跳开。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers and I leap back.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔进竹丛。
lines.en: I roll down the slope into the bamboo.
I thrash, my feathers soaked.

lines.zh: 爆声把我震得往旁边冲。
lines.en: The blast sends me charging sideways.
An arrow buries in my breast feathers.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的腿钉住了。
lines.en: That force nails my legs down.

lines.zh: 脚下的竹林没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The bamboo is gone; I fall.
